angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G), year-standardized, followed drill -> NFL bend / Turn Match -> career pressure rate, leave-one-class-out against the strongest no-tracking baseline (pick + role) and the full no-tracking model; six pre-listed drill measures tested jointly; reliability-corrected slopes; day-3 use reduced to a ranked 8-name film list
metric_name: Hoop G: hardest half-second of sideways lean on the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight (speed^2 / turn radius, in g; median 7.1 mph on a 1.8-yd radius = 0.62 g vs 5.6 mph on a 4.1-yd radius = 0.18 g on NFL rushes), harder of the two turns, z within Combine year
headline_number: Held out (n=77): +1.8 pressures per 450 rushes per sd [0.2, 3.4], best-of-six p=0.23. Against pick + role (R2 0.10): R2 gain 0.06 [90% -0.10, 0.20; six-measure adjusted -0.16, 0.29], slope 2.3 [0.9, 3.7]. Disattenuated 4.1 [0.4, 11.2]. Edge 2.2 (n=38) vs interior 1.8 (n=39). verify.py 2.4 reproduced exactly by switching to n=78 + median fill.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 22 cand_1 (8.36 avg). Lede rewritten as one verdict with the gain against the strongest no-tracking baseline and a multiplicity-adjusted interval; motivation paragraph (why hoop over burst drill, why day 3, why a 2026 test now); unit sanity check of 0.62 g vs 0.18 g (speed and radius on both sides) and left/right turn handling stated; graft from runner-up cand_2: drill rep vs NFL rep in coach units, extended into Turn Match (NFL turn radius / own hoop radius, median 2.7; drill radius -> NFL radius rho 0.01); Table 1 cut to 4 links, Table 2 to 2 rows (pick + role vs + Hoop G); Hoop G by edge vs interior; per-class bootstrap and leave-one-player-out for the 2025 class (flat, not reversed); errors-in-variables and empirical-Bayes reliability-corrected slopes; verify.py gap reconciled (n=78 set + median imputation give 2.4 and 2.3/3.9/0.7); Holm/BH, ridge/OLS variants, sha256, power, Spearman-Brown moved to an appendix; Go/No-go/Hold tiers replaced by one ranked list of 8 with one-line coaching reads and an explicit 'Hoop G does not change the board'; Fig 1 cut to two players with in-panel readouts, Fig 2 single panel with repeat-lap annotation and burst-band warning, Fig 4 true small multiples (rush fan + shared-axis strip, single x label); main text about 1,530 words plus a 200-word appendix; 2026 frozen rule now tests against pick + role.
open_risks: Still a null after the six-measure correction; the slope against pick + role passes BH but that baseline was chosen after seeing the data
Edge interval now spans zero at full bootstrap (2.2 [-0.2, 5.0]); the edge-only flag rests on football logic, not a separate significant result
Averaging both turns instead of keeping the harder one weakens the slope to 1.1 [-0.6, 2.8], so the signal sits in the harder turn
Turn Match shows the drill turn path does not appear in NFL rushes (rho 0.01), which supports 'shared skill, not path' but could be read as undercutting the drill
Coaching reads are hand-written from 16-19 sampled rushes each
Disattenuated slope interval is very wide (0.4 to 11.2) because one-lap reliability is itself uncertain
